test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which statement from the given options is NOT correct?

options.text: Buddhist scriptures werer written in Pali.
Charak was the personal physician of Gautam Buddha.
Upagupta influence Ashoka to embrace Buddhism.
The birth place of Gautam Buddha is in Nepal.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Charak was the personal physician of Gautam Buddha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Buddhist scriptures were written in Pali** which is historically accurate as Pali was the language used in many ancient Buddhist texts.
 
• **Charak was the personal physician of Gautam Buddha** is incorrect as Charak was a renowned ancient Indian physician, but there is no historical evidence to support that he was the personal physician of Gautam Buddha.
 
• **Upagupta influenced Ashoka to embrace Buddhism**, which is a well-documented historical fact.
 
• **The birth place of Gautam Buddha is in Nepal**, specifically in Lumbini, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Nepal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Charak** is a figure associated with ancient Indian medicine, particularly known for his work, the Charaka Samhita, which is a foundational text of Ayurveda.
 
• The **Buddhist scriptures** written in Pali include the Tipitaka, also known as the Pali Canon, which is the doctrinal foundation of Theravada Buddhism.
 
• **Upagupta** is traditionally considered to be the spiritual teacher of Emperor Ashoka and played a significant role in Ashoka's conversion to Buddhism.
 
• **Lumbini** is recognized as the birthplace of Gautam Buddha and holds significant historical and religious importance.
